rows: Who has zoning authority in the US?
Local governments (cities/counties), enabled by state law
Plan vs. zoning: what is the difference?
Plan = aspirational policy; zoning = legally binding land use regulation
Which planning theory is dominant today?
Communicative/collaborative, with equity/advocacy framing
What did Jacobs say was wrong with modernist planning?
Separated uses, superblocks, towers-in-park destroy the street life that creates safety and vitality
What was Haussmann's main tool?
Demolition + reconstruction: broad boulevards, sewers, uniform building envelope
What is the Jacobs-Moses conflict?
Jacobs (community/street life) vs Moses (auto/infrastructure/slum clearance): central tension of 20th-century American urbanism
What is New Urbanism's core claim?
Walkable, mixed-use, traditional neighborhood design creates more livable and sustainable places than conventional sprawl
Why is US planning fragmented?
Constitutional structure: land use = local police power; no national planning system
What is path dependency in cities?
Early investments (grids, transit lines, sewer systems, freeways) constrain all future options at enormous reversal cost
What is the software architecture analog to zoning?
API contract / interface spec: defines what can be built, enforced through a review process
